zm_monitor_q1_2024.notes: Last-resort source under RETRY2 route 4 (police figures quoted in reputable news). Read with WebFetch; the shell receives a 404 page from zambiamonitor.com, so no HTML copy is in raw/. Exact sentences in raw/quotes.txt. No national total printed; provinces sum to 194. problems: No official downloadable file with provincial murder counts exists online: Zambia Police Service releases quarterly statements only through the press. Earlier passes tried zambiapolice.gov.zm, zamstats.gov.zm, ISS Monograph 159 (2005 all-offence table only), HDX (nothing); web.archive.org unreachable from the shell. THIRD PASS 17 Oct: used route 4 (news quoting police). Searched for other quarters with provincial murder counts: Zambia Monitor Q3 2023 (?p=29171), Q1 2024 GBV statement (?p=40766), Q3 2024 (?p=51649) and Q2 2026 (?p=91825) give murder only as national GBV-related totals, no provinces; ?p=47161 is about extrajudicial killings (PPCC), not murder. Only Q1 and Q2 2024 provincial murder counts were found.
